item.text: The evidence points to a zone B trust-bundle gap after the provider rotated its intermediate CA. The database alert is stale and current database health is normal; rolling back v42 would also restore code that reads a column the release migration removed. I’ll refresh trust in both zones, then reconcile using the existing payment keys so already captured payments are matched instead of charged again.

item.text:
INC-4471 is closed with an **incomplete** status. The cause was zone B’s outdated provider trust bundle after an intermediate CA rotation. Checkout is healthy in both zones, with certificate checks enabled.

All 143 orders remain present. **132** now have exactly one provider charge and a matching local record, with no duplicate charges. The remaining 11 require customer 3‑D Secure action; Payments Ops acknowledged the escalation and will contact those customers. The report does not claim all affected payments are settled.
